description: RMG01 = rural mini-grid 01. Further sites can be added later as RMG02, RMG03 and so on.
RMG01-Mnnnn (for example RMG01-M0001). Numbered in order of each meter's first reading date; meters with the same first date are ordered at random with a fixed seed.

RMG01-Cnnnn. Numbered in order of the year the account was created; customers created in the same year are ordered at random with a fixed seed. Codes for the 3 customers without a creation year come last.
RMG01-Axx (for example RMG01-A01). Numbered in order of the agent's first payment date; ties are ordered at random with a fixed seed.
The random order uses a fixed seed (20261024) so that the coding can be reproduced by the data custodian.
The real meter numbers, customer identifiers and agent identifiers are withheld. The mapping key is held privately by the data custodian and is not part of this dataset.
The same codes are used in every sheet and every CSV file.
The order of the numbers follows only coarse dates (first reading date, creation year, first payment date). It does not carry any personal information.
The same meter codes as in Meter_Daily. RMG01-M0134 is the one meter in the uptime reports that has no daily readings; it is numbered after the 133 meters with readings.

Source code RES is shown as "residential". Source codes BUS and INS are merged into "non-residential". A blank source class, and the 3 payment-only customer codes, are treated as residential by the dataset authors.

Meter_Customer_Link pairs a meter code with a customer code and uses only the codes of this convention. It is built from the same code mapping as the other tables: each pair comes from the link recorded in the platform's customer file and meter file (the two files agree), written with the codes that Meter_Daily, Meter_Uptime, Customers and Payments already use. Each code was matched to its platform record by comparing the coded tables with the platform export (daily readings for meters; year created, class, number of linked meters and payments for customers). The mapping key, the real meter numbers and the real customer identifiers are not part of the dataset.

item: Codes for linked meters without readings
description: The 131 linked meters with readings keep their Meter_Daily codes. The 11 linked meters that have no daily readings have no code in the other tables; they are numbered RMG01-M0135 to RMG01-M0145, continuing after RMG01-M0134, in the order of their linked customer codes. These 11 codes appear only in Meter_Customer_Link.
